'''Illor Ptoc''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]]. He ruled with an iron fist, and prided himself on the low crime rate and the high productivity of Demophon's citizens.
